opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to achieve their full potential.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to postdoctoral researchers to support pilot studies, develop new techniques, finalize projects, and promote knowledge transfer and impact.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to Society members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct publishable educational research.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct publishable educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to Society members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop new techniques, finalize projects, or promote knowledge transfer and impact.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalize a project, and supports activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full members or Fellows in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for members to run activities that address equity, diversity, and inclusion principles.
